notes.text: In the linked passage, Rabbi Yitzchak son of Rabbi Yaakov bar Giyori sends a ruling in Rabbi Yochanan’s name.

[Heilprin’s entry for Yaakov](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2107&lang=en) questions whether Yaakov was a student of Rabbi Yochanan and points instead to his son. [His entry for Yitzchak](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2170&lang=en) compares Eruvin 62a with the locator 42a in his printed text.
